answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the pigment of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The violet is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the oasis.
